A '''crocodile''' was creature in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[grakkt]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], had a head that resembled a crocodile and the body of an [[Armor/Legends|armored]] [[Lion/Legends|lion]].<ref name="Invasion">[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game|''Star Wars: Invasion of Theed'' Adventure Game]]</ref> [[Likka]]s, a species from the planet [[Abonshee]], resembled long-legged crocodiles.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
